dedupe_keys.name: icasa south africa provincial quality of service reports and state of the ict sector reports

description: The Independent Communications Authority of South Africa publishes two report series useful for network models. The quality of service reports present the regulator's measurements of mobile network performance by province and metro, such as Gauteng in 2011, Eastern Cape and Gauteng in 2013, Johannesburg and Pretoria, KwaZulu-Natal in the fourth quarter of 2015-16, Limpopo in the first quarter of 2016-17 and Mpumalanga, with indicators such as call setup success, dropped calls and data throughput per operator. The ICT indicators section holds the State of the ICT Sector in South Africa reports, which compile market data from licensees on subscriptions, traffic, revenue, investment, coverage by technology and broadband prices; the page lists the 2017 and 2018 reports, while later editions appear elsewhere on the site. ICASA also publishes 5G reports, spectrum plans, retail tariff reports and a type approval database. Coverage: South Africa, national and by province. Format and access: PDF reports, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: quality measurements are dated and irregular; indicators are national aggregates in the sector reports; later sector reports were not located in this pass. Simulation uses: provincial mobile performance baselines and national coverage and demand for South African telecom models. Related records: the GMICP media and internet concentration data include South Africa; the ITU ICT statistics give comparable series.
